mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals expanding economic activity, which should positively influence S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases by 5% YoY but SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong economic output, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO growth exceeds 2% YoY but SPX 60-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 2% signals monetary easing, boosting equity markets and leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS falls below 2% but SPX 20-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% may signal tight labor markets, potentially leading to inflation and negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) is low and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is high, it may indicate tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is low and FEDFUNDS is high but SPX 60-day returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases by 5% MoM but SPX 5-day returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with falling housing starts (HOUST) may indicate economic imbalances, leading to negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If INDPRO rises and HOUST falls but SPX 60-day returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth (GDPC1) below 2% YoY signals economic downturn, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth is below 2% YoY but SPX 60-day returns are positive.
